title: The limits of Schur multipliers in Pólya conversion problems for the $q$-permanent function
summary: This paper studies generalized Pólya conversion problems for the $q$-permanent. We establish a sharp threshold governing the transition from low-dimensional algebraic flexibility to higher-dimensional combinatorial rigidity. For $n \ge 3$ and $q \ne \pm 1$, we prove that the $q$-permanent is not linearly convertible to the determinant or permanent. Conversely, we completely classify the space of Schur multiplier preservers for $n=2$.
